ruleDefinitions.name: Python Reverse Shell Execution Via PTY And Socket Modules
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of python with calls to the socket and pty module in order to connect and spawn a potential reverse shell.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX(".*python.*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-c\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*import.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*pty.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*socket.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*spawn.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.connect.*")))
